**Subject:** B4 pallet fall — logged, and why I haven't written it up as forklift impact

I've recorded both witness accounts word for word and flagged the difference between them. I haven't written it up as "the forklift hit the rack." Here's why.

Paul says the beam was already bent and he set the pallet down cleanly. Sara says the forklift caught the upright as it pulled away and the pallet then slid off. Those two accounts point at different problems, and I can't pick one on the strength of a preference — including yours, and including mine. Paul's account is the one that would put him at fault, and he's the only person who was on the truck; writing the conclusion against his own statement, without checking it, is the version most likely to be challenged later by him, by Sara, by an insurer or by an inspector.

If the truck did catch the upright, the problem is impact damage going unnoticed, and an inspection regime that only looks at beams won't catch it.
